forces: Eleven downstream issues consume one delivery conformance reference; duplicated or per-issue delivery semantics would diverge immediately.
The four delivery classes are frozen in delivery_class_contracts; the specification must make them observable without redefining or weakening a single row.
Every delivery state and transition needs a deterministic externally observable outcome or downstream conformance testing cannot exist.
Exactly-once claims are forbidden by the frozen contract; at-most-once and at-least-once classifications must stay per class.
The platform-neutral semantic contract must not name or require any transport, queue, outbox, collector, or storage runtime mechanism.
Attacker-controlled payloads and retry pressure must not create ambiguous acceptance, unbounded resource use, or fail-open validation.
The version dimension is already settled by the exact-one package support policy and must be consumed rather than re-decided.
policy_critical behavior requires policy-owner approval before production, so the contract must specify the blocked-pending hole rather than fill it.

approach-extend-event-contract-capabilit.reason: A delivery conformance contract is a distinct reusable surface consumed by delivery implementations and their conformance tests, not another clause of the event contract's own content. Folding it into security-audit-event-contract would also make the delta a contract-reuse trigger path, and the delivery dimension the issue needs is observable delivery behavior above the event contract rather than a change to the frozen contract itself. Keeping the capabilities separate preserves the frozen event contract untouched and gives the downstream wave one stable reference path.

approach-specify-security-significant-on.reason: The issue requires one common conformance contract whose at-most-once and at-least-once classification covers all four classes; security_significant receives primary depth, but the classification, the exactly-once prohibition, and the policy_critical blocked-pending hole are only coherent as one closed surface. Deferring three classes would leave the downstream issues without the per-class classification they consume and would re-open the boundary the orchestrator already decided.
